about: the analog stick in the settings (2026-11-20, controls -- the user: 'I still don't see the analog stick map-able in settings'): F2 > CONTROLS > ALL CONTROLLERS: BUTTONS & STICK opened in the QA Royal Rumble (qa_op 22), its first row ANALOG STICK asked for (qa_bind_row 20: the whole stick); the scripted pad 1 pushes its LEFT stick left -- the capture puts the N64 stick on the left stick (all four ways, '[pads] controllers (the default): the analog stick = the left stick', saved in controls_n64.json) and takes the left stick off the d-pad rows. Every 4 s again: with the capture over, LEFT on the ANALOG STICK row is the left stick again (the row's LEFT / RIGHT). Read the log and the copy's controls_n64.json after the run.

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: the capture ended with the stick set and saved
